raw_segments.text: Don Pedro, come, you shake the head it's so long a-breathing, but I warrant thee, Claudio,
the time shall not go dully by us.
I will in the interim undertake one of Hercules' labors, which is, to bring Signor Benedict
and the Lady Beatrice into a mountain of affection the one with the other.
I would fain have it a match, and I doubt not but to fashion it, if you three will but
minister such assistance as I shall give you direction.
